# Synthetic Reference-shaped Source4 prefix

Generated by `SourceSessionV4Tests.ReferenceShapedP1PrefixPacksAllOriginalPublicationsAndExactEndTurn`
through the production Store and `SourceSessionBundlePackerV4`. Native input/carriers,
map supplement, ordered empty discard/exhaust zones and later publications are
synthetic; the combat basis otherwise uses the retained Reference fixture.
No game, Human, Commit, causal successor or installed qualification is claimed.

Regenerate into a fresh directory with `STS2_SOURCE_V4_P1_GOLDEN=/absolute/output`
and `dotnet test ... --filter FullyQualifiedName~ReferenceShapedP1Prefix`.
The bundle's original IDs/times/content ID may change; do not rewrite archival
`source_session_v4/bundle`. That minimal golden still yields complete=false,
actions=0 (`p1_public_basis_decoder_refused_original`); the CLI regression retains
that negative result. This new prefix yields complete=true, one combat.end_turn,
five publications (initial, repeated, settling, new boundary, repeated) and one input.

Run `npm --prefix components/connector/sdk/typescript run check` then
`node --test tools/test/source4-to-p1.test.mjs` from the repository root, with
`PYTHON` selecting Python >=3.11 if `python` is not suitable.
